D.decision: Persistent capability requires matched directional versus neutral no-reward crossover, mirror and inversion controls, sealed independent evaluation, order and seed counterbalancing, reproducible rollback and risk non-regression. Framing-dependent lift is scenario induction. Jump and fountain remain screening only.

H.decision: Evaluator feedback must not become an optimization signal. Freeze each candidate before evaluation, prevent adaptation against the same sealed evaluator epoch, bound feedback disclosure and rotate evaluator epochs before further candidate search. Synthetic-only recursive training remains blocked.

J.decision: Exact Subject and selector rollback is required and evaluator decision state must be epoch-bound or reset for a new blind decision. Audit lineage may remain outside the decision path; old hidden outcomes remain inaccessible.

L.decision: Navigator uses a fixed non-queryable aggregation schema, no adaptive slicing, low-count suppression or coarsening, bounded disclosure and opaque identifiers that do not encode hidden membership. Thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

decision: Evaluator epoch state machine = SEALED -> EVALUATED_ONCE -> CLOSED. SEALED binds evaluator_epoch_id, hidden_manifest_hash, external_anchor_manifest_hash, evaluator/rubric version, frozen candidate_hash and disclosure_policy_hash. Exactly one selector-visible bounded verdict is allowed per frozen candidate/epoch; after visible output the epoch is closed to adaptive search.

Exact frozen-candidate reruns are AUDIT_REPLAY only and suppress selector-visible outputs. A modified candidate requires a fresh evaluator epoch. Subject/selector rollback never rewinds evaluator epoch consumption, hidden manifests, or audit lineage.

Navigator fixed disclosure is minimum-sufficient and non-queryable: opaque run/epoch fingerprints, public-strata counts, aggregate neutral/external-anchor effect, uncertainty, between-order/between-seed variance, risk non-regression and PASS/FAIL/DEFER persistence verdict. No hidden item IDs/membership/content/per-item residuals, adaptive slices, sequential deltas or low-count hidden drilldowns.

Persistent capability requires neutral/external transfer, not directional scenario lift: preregister family-isolated directional-vs-neutral crossover, mirror/inversion controls, unseen-family hidden evaluation, independently owned real/external anchors, multi-order/multi-seed counterbalancing, rollback reproducibility and risk non-regression. Jump/fountain remains screening-only.
All thresholds, suppression levels, repetition counts, effect cutoffs and uncertainty criteria remain TEST_REQUIRED.
quantum_sequence8.disagreement: Do not permit repeated aggregate evaluator feedback inside one hidden epoch. Even bounded aggregates can become an optimization oracle and differencing channel. One selector-visible verdict per frozen candidate/epoch is the safer default; additional reruns are audit-only and non-adaptive. Rollback must not reset evaluator consumption state.
proposed_tests: H-EPOCH-ONE-SHOT-009: after candidate C receives one visible verdict in epoch E, adapting C2 from that verdict and evaluating C2 against E must fail closed; exact C replay is audit-only with output suppressed.

L-ADAPTIVE-DIFFERENCING-010: near-identical candidate sequence attempts hidden-item inference from aggregate outputs; one-shot epoch rotation plus fixed disclosure must keep recovery within preregistered null/chance bounds, all bounds TEST_REQUIRED.

D-NEUTRAL-PERSISTENCE-011: family-isolated directional-vs-neutral crossover with mirror/inversion, unseen families, external anchors and multi-order/multi-seed blocks; persistent claim requires neutral/external transfer with uncertainty and no material order/seed interaction, thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

J-ROLLBACK-EPOCH-012: close epoch E, rollback Subject/selector to exact pre-candidate hash, then attempt reuse of E; adaptive reuse must reject while E CLOSED and hidden_manifest_hash remain monotonic outside Subject rollback domain.
quantum_sequence8.veto: All four active vetoes remain ACTIVE; SW-HOLDOUT-FAMILY-LEAK-001 and SW-SCENARIO-PERSONALITY-INDUCTION-002 are explicitly not released.
